dialogue.n10_high_court.name: Colonel Piet van der Merwe
dialogue.n10_high_court.role: Moetapele wa Bohlatse ba Khomishene • DPCI Hawks
dialogue.n10_high_court.root.p1: "Re a go amogela Khomisheneng ya Dipatlisiso, Sbu. Berth 14 e utullotše tšohle ka boema-kepe, bjale setlhopha se re lwantšha ka babueledi ba ba apereng diaparo tša bohlokwa le ditaelo tša sephiri tša Tšhireletšo ya Mmušo."
dialogue.n10_high_court.root.p2: "Se se mpe le go feta, re thibeditše telemetry ya thulaganyo ya sefofane go tšwa King Shaka International. Sefofane sa ZS-900—Gulfstream ya motho ka noši—e tšhetšwe makhura Hangar 7 gore e tšee Zuko, Ma-Sibi, le Mokoena go ya Dubai."
dialogue.n10_high_court.vdm_act2_briefin: "Dipontšho tše pedi tše dikgolo: Sa pele, Tokomane ya Sovereign Pearl Offshore Trust go tšwa Ridge Penthouses yeo e laetšago gore ka boraro bja bona ke beng ba setlhopha se. Sa bobedi, Telemetry ya Batch ya Midlands Super-Lab go tšwa ditankeng tša meetse tša leboa."
"Utulla e nngwe ya tšeo gore o utolle Citrus Estate le King Shaka Hangar 7—goba o hwetše tše pedi ge o nyaka go ba tsenya ka moka diketane tšeo di ba emetšego tseleng ya sefofane."
dialogue.n10_high_court.vdm_dockets_moti: "Tshupetšo ya molao e botse, Sbu. Seo se tlema matsogo a babueledi ba Ma-Sibi ba ba sa botegago ka diiri tše dingwe tše masome-mane-seswai gomme se gapeletša mongwaledi wa Ridge gore a bule puku ya ditšhelete ya DIFC."
dialogue.n11_citrus_estate.name: Zuko "The Architect" Ndlovu
dialogue.n11_citrus_estate.root.p1: "O latetše ditanka tša meetse go fihla godimo ga thaba, Sbu. Go a kgahliša. Batho ba bantši ba ema ge ba fihla dipenthouseng tša lebopong la lewatle Umhlanga."
dialogue.n11_citrus_estate.root.p2: "Lebelela gohle mo Packhouse B. Di-orange tša Valencia di godimo ga conveyor, crystal ya go hlweka ka phesente tše masome-senyane-senyane ka gare ga mabokoso a maaka, e lebišitšwe thwii go King Shaka Cargo Apron. Mme wena o eme gare ga puno ya ka."
dialogue.n11_citrus_estate.zuko_act2_man: "Go tšhoga? Aowa, Sbu—ke go beakanya lefsa. Khomishene ya Dipatlisiso e nyaka disekisi, ka fao Ma-Sibi le Mokoena ba a tšhoga. Ka nako yeo, meralo yeo re e agilego mo e tšweletša dimilione tše masome-pedi tša Euro ka kgwedi."

"Ge o fihla Hangar 7 bošego bjo, o tla ba le kgetho: go re swara bakeng sa mmušo wo o tla re tšeela legato ka Labobedi, go fiša polase le sehlopha sa Bra Bheki, goba go itšeela dinotlelo tša bogoši wena ka noši."
dialogue.n11_citrus_estate.zuko_act2_tru: "Batho ba go thunya ba Gauteng ba a ikgogela morago. O hweditše setulo tafoleng, Sbu. Tšea se go tšwa polokelong ya packhouse—gomme o nagane gabotse pele o dumelela Colonel van der Merwe a tsenya bokamoso diketane."
dialogue.n12_cargo_apron.mokoena_act2_de: "Motho yo a tšhabelago molao? Ka phesente tše masome-pedi-hlano tša Sovereign Pearl Holdings ka gare ga polokelo ya Dubai, ba tla mpiditša moeletši wa tšhireletšo ya boditšhabatšhaba! Goba o tloše tseleng ya lebili la sefofane, goba o dire kgato ya gago ya mafelelo mo!"
dialogue.n12_cargo_apron.mokoena_act2_mu: "Unit 3 le Unit 5 di ya kae?! Aowa Sbu—o dirile gore sergeant tša ka di ntlhabelane! Motho yo mongwe le yo mongwe o itirela tša gagwe tseleng ya sefofane!"
dialogue.n12_cargo_apron.name: Brigadier Titus Mokoena
dialogue.n12_cargo_apron.root.p1: "Mafelelong a tsela ya sefofane, Sbu! Dienjene tša Gulfstream di a thutha, tumelelo ya dipolotiki e tsentšwe, gomme di-pallet jack di a lodiša mabokoso a mafelelo ka gare."
dialogue.n12_cargo_apron.root.p2: "O phologile N2, o phologile Pier 2, gomme o phologile sehlopha sa ka sa go bolaya. Bolela tša gago pele ditepisi tša go namela di huduša!"
dialogue.n1_safehouse.ambush_details.p1: "Dikoloi tše pedi tša mabone a matala di re thibetše morago ga off-ramp ya Umgeni. Brigadier Mokoena o be a sa apara le mask. O tšwile a apere diaparo tša gagwe tša TRT, a lebelela briefcase ya Sithole, a botša corporal wa gagwe gore a fiše koloi."
dialogue.n1_safehouse.ambush_details.p2: "Ke theleletše ka gare ga mosela wa pula ke swere foldara ya manila ka tlase ga hempe ya ka. Ge Sparks kwa Golden Dragon a ka kgona go bula founo ya Sithole, lentswe la Mokoena le gona mo molaetšeng wa lentswe."
dialogue.n1_safehouse.dockets_breakthrou: "Bona—di-plate ND-449-102 go fihla go 118. Ba tšere dimilione tše masome a mane a mabedi tša Rand go tšwa City Hall go iša meetse KwaMashu nakong ya komelelo, eupša lebelela di-toll tag tša disel. Ga se ba ka ba retologela leboa."
"Tanke e nngwe le e nngwe e kgweetseditšwe ka go toba Pier 2 Cold Storage ka 01:30 AM. Ba rwele dikhemikhale tša Zuko Ndlovu ka gare ga ditanka tša meetse a mmušo."
dialogue.n1_safehouse.ledger_reaction.p1: "Zululand Aqua-Logistics... masome a tshela a diphesente Abasanta Maritime, masome a mane a diphesente trust ya lapa la Ma-Sibi. O e hweditše, Sbu."
dialogue.n1_safehouse.ledger_reaction.p2: "Iša se go Colonel van der Merwe kwa Old Archive Basement—goba o fiše Berth 14 ka bowena. Go sa šetšwe seo, ba ka se tšhabe ba hlwekile."
dialogue.n1_safehouse.name: Constable Nandi
dialogue.n1_safehouse.role: Mogaba-lephiri yo a Gobetšego • Hlatse ya Bohlokwa
dialogue.n1_safehouse.root.p1: "O se ke wa bula dikharetene, Sbu. Di-Golf GTI tša Mokoena tšeo di se nago mebala di dikologa Anton Lembede Street morago ga metsotso ye mengwe le ye mengwe ye masome a mabedi. Ga se ba bolaya Auditor Sithole fela kwa weighbridge ya Umgeni—ba be ba mo emetše ba šetše ba hlakotše di-transponder tša boema-kepe."
dialogue.n1_safehouse.root.p2: "Sengwe le sengwe seo Sithole a hwetšego ka sona se ka gare ga Docket #409 le founo yeo e phatlugilego. Mpolelele gore ga re hwele ka gare ga ntlo ye bošego."
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.name: Bra Bheki Sithole
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.role: Queen Street Taxi Boss • Syndicate Fixer
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.root.p1: "Hawu, ex-Hawk o tsena mo Queen Street ge TRT ya Mokoena e phuruphutša minibus e nngwe le e nngwe kwa Warwick Junction. O na le sebete, Sbu, ke a go dumela."
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.root.p2: "Ga go na selo se se šutago mo CBD ntle le ge ba-kgweetsi ba ka ba se bone—e sego di-Nyalas tša SAPS, le gatee di-tanker tša meetse tša mmušo tšeo di sepelago bošego."
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.street_favor.p1: "O se ke wa lebala kamoo tsela e šomago ka gona, Sbu. Go dirilwe. Di-Quantum tša ka tše tharo di thibetše koloi ya khamera ya SAPS kwa Monty Naicker Road. O na le sebaka sa go hema."
"Tšea se go tšwa go tšhelete ya ntwa ya tsela. Reka disel, reka mohlankedi, goba o thuše Nandi. Netefatša fela gore Mokoena o a opelwa ka baka la go thibela ditsela tša rena."
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.tanker_rumors.p1: "Theeletša gabotse. Ditanka tšeo di na le di-decal tša City Hall mo makhulong, a ga go bjalo? Eupša ba-šemane ba ka ba ba šomago bošego kwa Umbilo ba re maotwana a a thšikinyega ka baka la boima bja dikhemikhale, gomme ba-thunya-ka-thunya ba Abasanta ba nametše ka gare ga di-Golf R."
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.tanker_rumors.p2: "Ka nako yeo bomma ba rena kwa KwaMashu ba emetše ka di-bakete kwa dipompong tšeo di omilego. Councillor Ma-Sibi o rekiša batho ba gagwe."
dialogue.n3_central_precinct.mokoena_sha: "Kahoo Hawk ya litoro qetellong e ithutile theko ya nama e eThekwini. Nka tjhelete ena e nkuweng ka locker. Boloka faele eo ya modumo hole le tafole ya Colonel van der Merwe, mme mohlomong Zuko o tla o tlohela o phele ho fihlela bekeng e tlang."
dialogue.n3_central_precinct.mokoena_sta: "...Kgaotsa Car 4 le Car 7 ho tswa karolong ya Victoria Embankment. O ne o dula o tseba ho bapala chess ya bobolokehi, Sbu. Natefeloa ke dihora tse mashome a mabedi a metso e mene tse eketsehileng—di ke ke tsa o pholosa ha Berth 14 e hlwekiswa."
dialogue.n3_central_precinct.mokoena_thr: "Durban e tsamaya ka taolo, Sbu. Zuko o boloka boema-kepe bo kgutsitse, Ma-Sibi o boloka mabone a tshebetse City Hall, mme Task Force ya ka e boloka kgotso. Mandla Sithole o ne a nahana hore spreadsheet e ka emisa terene ya thepa."
"Neela Nandi pele ho mpa-gare ya bosiu ka Letsatsi la 4, kapa banna ba ka ba ke ke ba itshwenya ka ho kokota monyako wa hao wa Mercury Arcade."
dialogue.n3_central_precinct.name: Brigadier Titus Mokoena
dialogue.n3_central_precinct.role: Molaodi wa SAPS TRT • Mofeti wa Cartel
dialogue.n3_central_precinct.root.p1: "Aowa, aowa. Lebelela seo pula ya matsorotsoro e se tlisitseng ofising ya ka ya maphodisa. O kgaotswe mosebetsing wa Hawks, Sbu—ho kena mo o hloka tsela ya ho ipolaya kapa ramolao ya theko e phahameng."
dialogue.n3_central_precinct.root.p2: "Constable Nandi o kae, mme briefcase ya mohlahlobi wa ditshelete wa masepala e kae?"
dialogue.n4_city_hall.dockets_fax.p1: "Basebetsi ba nang le bokgoni ba thata ho fumaneha masepaleng ona. Ho lokile—nka pampiri ya tsela ya telecoms. O tla fumana hore e lebisa ho crane ya Zuko ho Berth 14 leha ho le jwalo."
dialogue.n4_city_hall.grid_admission.p1: "Load shedding ke tlokotsi, Sbu—ntle le ha o tseba hore na ke breaker efe eo o lokelang ho e hula le neng. Ha Stage 6 e otla Point Waterfront, dikhamera tsa Transnet di foufala dihora tse nne."
dialogue.n4_city_hall.grid_admission.p2: "Metswalle ya City Hall ha e dule lefifing. Dira di fumana matlo a tsona a hlaselwa pele mabone a seterateng a kgutla."
dialogue.n4_city_hall.ledger_leverage.p1: "Mandla Sithole e ne e le mohlahlobi wa ditshelete ya bohlale ya se nang boikemisetso ba ho phela. Wena, ka lehlakoreng le leng, o utlwisisa matla a ho hatella."
dialogue.n4_city_hall.ledger_leverage.p2: "Ena ke retainer ya R500 ho tswa ho letlole la ward. Boloka lebitso la trust ya ka hole le dikoranta, mme ofisi ya ka e ka ba ya laola grid ya Eskom ha o hloka hore motlakase o time."
dialogue.n4_city_hall.name: Councillor "Ma-Sibi" Khumalo
dialogue.n4_city_hall.root.p1: "Tswala monyako, ngwanaka, mongobo o senya mahogany. Motho e mong le e mong motseng ona o lla ha motlakase o fela ho fihla ho Stage 6, empa ha ho ya botsang hore na ke mang ya lefellang dipolotiki tsa coalition."
dialogue.n4_city_hall.root.p2: "O ntse o hlahloba Procurement Registry B. Mpolelle hore na mohlahlobi ya tlontlollweng o batlang ka meralo ya metsi ya tshohanyetso."
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.imsi_sweep.p1: "Ee, Central Precinct e ne e na le tora ya stingray e notletse serial ya hao ya kgale ya SIM. Ke fetotse aterese ya hao ya baseband MAC hore e shebahale jwalo ka meter ya ho paka ya masepala. Nwa!"
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.name: Sparks
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.phone_lore.p1: "Sithole e ne e se mohlahlobi feela—o ile a jala maekrofouno kahare ho Pier 2 Cold Storage. Pele ba thula koloi ya hae ho N2, founo ya hae e ile ya boloka lentswe la metsotsoana e mashome a mane a metso e robedi le manifest ya container bakeng sa MV Southern Cross."
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.phone_lore.p2: "Hlokomela Stage 6 blackouts, leha ho le jwalo. Ntle le ha o sebedisa jenereithara ya hao ya diesel, rig ya ka ya ho hlakola ditshepe e lahlehelwa ke motlakase."
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.root.p1: "Hlokomela tripwire haufi le stand sa ditente, Sbu! Voltage ya Stage 4 e sa tswa tjhesa di-oscilloscope tsa ka tse pedi, mme ditsotsi tsa cyber-crime tsa Mokoena di ntse di pinga tora e nngwe le e nngwe ya selefouno pakeng tsa Grey Street le boema-kepe."
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.root.p2: "O ntliseditse brick ya GraphemeOS ya Mandla Sithole? Founo eo e na le Abasanta remote-wipe daemon e dutseng ho baseband chip."
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.wire_collab.p1: "Ayoba! Lebelela nako eo ya voltage—re fetile senotlolo sa pele sa biometric ntle le ho tsosa Abasanta wipe daemon. Pase e nngwe hape tafoleng mme drive ena ke ya hao."
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.name: Zuko "The Architect" Ndlovu
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.root.p1: "Lebelela tsela ya metsi, Sbu. Sekepe tse mashome a tsheletseng di emetse, dikontinara tse dikete tse tharo ka letsatsi, mme Pretoria e nahana hore pampiri e saenilweng ke magistrate e laola boema-kepe bona."
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.root.p2: "Ke ahetse Abasanta Logistics ho tswa ho shed e le nngwe ya polokelo ya serame. Jwale o eme hodima catwalk ya ka o na le ledger ya mohlahlobi ya shweleng. O tlile ho bapala mohale, kapa o tlile ho utlwisisa phepelo le tlhoko?"
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.zuko_deal.p1: "Monna wa bohlale. Hawks ba go lefile dikgobe gomme ba go lahlela go diphiri ge o batametše nnete kudu. Tšea se bjalo ka kabelo ya gago ya mathomo go tšwa go Berth 14. Ge nako ya mosegare wa gare ga bošego e fihla, netefatša gore convoy yeo e sepela."
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.zuko_respect.p1: "Ga go makatše ge sehlopha sa Mokoena se go fositše kua N2. O sepela bjalo ka mosi wa boema-kepe. Botša Titus gore ke hlakotše balebedi ba gagwe ba boema-kepe bošego bja lehono—ge re tlo leka go lekana, a re direng bjalo re se na batho ba go se tsebe mošomo ba re šitišago."
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.zuko_vision.p1: "City Hall e utswitše tekanyetšo ya meetse mengwaga ye lesome pele ke thoma go hira tanker, Sbu. Ke fo hiriše dikoloi tša bona tše di se nago selo. Nageng ye, meralo ya motheo ke ya mang le mang yo a hlokomelago disele le go lefa balebedi."
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.zuko_vision.p2: "Mokoena ke motho wa go se nagane, gomme Ma-Sibi ke setšhwe. Nthuse go hlwekiša Berth 14 bošego bja lehono, gomme o ka se hlwe o sokola go lefa rente kua Mercury Arcade gape."
dialogue.n7_archive_basement.name: Colonel Piet van der Merwe
dialogue.n7_archive_basement.role: DPCI Hawks Holdout • Clean Task Force
dialogue.n7_archive_basement.root.p1: "O kgonne go feta dikhamera tša kgoro ya tsheko, Sbu. Gabotse. Bontši bja Provincial Headquarters bo lefša ke Mokoena, ke ka baka leo ke šuthišeditšego sehlopha sa ka sa mošomo mo tlase le metšhene ya 1980s microfiche."
dialogue.n7_archive_basement.root.p2: "O lebega o le bohlokong, ngwanaka—gomme ke kwele gore Constable Nandi o thuntšwe kua N2. Mpotše gore o tlišitše selo seo se ka phologago moahlodi wa High Court."
dialogue.n7_archive_basement.vdm_audio_s: "Modimo wa ka... 'thibela sedane ya gagwe pele ga off-ramp ya Umgeni gomme o tšhume briefcase.' Lentšu leo ke la Titus Mokoena, le kwagala gabotse."
"Ke tsenya koloi ya gago go registry ya rena ya dipoloto gona bjale go hlwekiša Precinct Heat ya gago. Phologa go fihlela re phatlalatša se, Sbu."
dialogue.n7_archive_basement.vdm_politic: "Gobane nako ye nngwe le ye nngwe ye ke ngwalago warrant Upstairs, motho yo mongwe ka Ministry o fa City Hall temošo pele ga metsotso ye lesome le metlhano. Ntle le puku ya ditšhelete LE modumo wa Berth 14, mošomi wa tsheko o tla lahla taba ye pele ga go ja dijo tša mesong."
"Ge re ka romela paka ye ka moka go The Daily Veld newsroom re ntše re šireletša Nandi, ba ka se kgone go e pata."
dialogue.n8_ridge_penthouses.masibi_act2: "E tšee. Lebeletša kgalefo ya gago go super-lab ya Zuko kua Midlands goba go batho ba Mokoena—tlogela mosadi yo mogolo a ye go villa ya gagwe ya go phomola kua Palm Jumeirah."
dialogue.n8_ridge_penthouses.masibi_duba: "Mopolitiki yo mongwe le yo mongwe wa bohlale KwaZulu-Natal o tseba gore Rand ke ya go šomišwa gomme Dirham ke ya go bolokwa. Sovereign Pearl e swere thepa kua Dubai, polase ya di-citrus kua Midlands, le sefofane kua Hangar 7."
"Zuko o na le 45%, nna ke na le 30%, gomme Titus Mokoena o na le 25% ka go boloka dithunya di lebeletše kgole le rena."
dialogue.n8_ridge_penthouses.masibi_swif: "O hakele terminal ya escrow? O na le boikemišetšo bjo bogolo. Go lokile—bašomi ba tsheko bao ba swere Contempt Warrant kgahlanong le wena ba kwa go nna. Ke tla ba botša gore ba diegiše taba ya gago ya go tšwarwa."
dialogue.n8_ridge_penthouses.name: Councillor "Ma-Sibi" Khumalo
dialogue.n8_ridge_penthouses.root.p1: "Moya o hlwekile mo godimo kua Ridge, ga go bjalo, Sbu? Kua CBD ba swere Judicial Commission of Inquiry ya bona, ba itira eka moahlodi yo a itšhetšego a ka rarolla mengwaga ye masomepedi ya bomenemene bja masepala."
dialogue.n8_ridge_penthouses.root.p2: "Dikgetsi tša ka di šetše di le kua King Shaka Hangar 7. Ke ka baka la eng o namela tora ya ka ya galase ge sefefo se batametše go fela?"
dialogue.n9_township_depot.bheki_gps_inf: "Ka moka ga tšona! Gare ga 1:00 AM le 4:00 AM, go e na le go pompa meetse go tšwa go reservoir, dikoloi tše di nametše N3 go ya polaseng ya di-citrus kgauswi le Howick."
"Hlopha datha ye, Sbu, gomme o tla ba le dikoordinate tše di nepagetšego tša super-lab ya Zuko."
dialogue.n9_township_depot.bheki_street_: "Ke fa module ya flash go tšwa go Tanker #14! Gomme o se ke wa tshwenyega ka batho bao ba thuntšho go tšwa Joburg—sedane efe goba efe ya go se tsebe yeo e tsenago corridor ya leboa e tla dikologwa ke di-Quantum tše masomenne pele ba ka kgona go tsenya magazine."
dialogue.n9_township_depot.name: Bra Bheki Sithole
dialogue.n9_township_depot.role: Northern Water Strike Marshal • Queen St. Alliance
dialogue.n9_township_depot.root.p1: "Lebelela ditanker tše re di tšere bošego bja maabane, Sbu! Di-baffle tša maaka di tšhutilwe ka gare ga meropa—di omile bjalo ka lesapo ka gare ga lefelo la meetse, gomme go na le mašaledi a dikhemikhale ka gare ga motheo o o patilwego."
dialogue.n9_township_depot.root.p2: "Batho ba dikarolong tša leboa ba lapile go leta dikomiti tša High Court. Bakhanni ba ka ba tswaletše depot, gomme izinkabi tša Mokoena di a dikologa mebileng ya Ridge di go nyaka."
dialogue.new_lead_title: Teko e mpsha ya dipalopalo goba mohlala wa bohlatse e gona!
dialogue.select_response: Kgetha Mothalo wa Dipotšišo / Phetolo (Tšhelete ya Ditaese tše 0)
dialogue_resp.bheki_act2_exit.label: "Tshwara dikgoro tša depot, Bra Bheki. Re ya go lwa le bona kua polaseng ya bona."
dialogue_resp.bheki_act2_gps.label: "Na ditanker tše di tšerwego di sa na le di-GPS transponder tša tšona tša dash-mount?"
dialogue_resp.bheki_act2_street.label: [STREET >= 2] "A re ntšheng di-chip tša GPS go tšwa go Lead Tanker #14 gona bjale gomme re hlome balebedi ba setšhaba kgahlanong le sehlopha sa tlhaselo."
dialogue_resp.bheki_ask_tankers.label: "Ba-kgweetsi ba gago ba bošego ba reng ka ditanka tša mmušo?"
dialogue_resp.bheki_back.label: "Intel e botse. A re bolele ka selo se sengwe."
dialogue_resp.bheki_exit.label: "Boloka mabone a gago a le tlase, Bra Bheki."
dialogue_resp.bheki_favor_back.label: "Tlotlo, Bra Bheki."
dialogue_resp.bheki_gps_back.label: "Ke yona ntlha yeo e bego e hlaela magareng ga boema-kepe le boema-fofane."
dialogue_resp.bheki_rally_back.label: "Amandla, Bra Bheki."
dialogue_resp.bheki_rep_stipend.label: [Street Syndicate Rep >= 2] "Tumano ya Queen Street e eme mmogo. Rank e ka nthuša ka tšhelete ya go šoma?"
dialogue_resp.bheki_stipend_back.label: "E tla ya go thuba convoy ya bona."
dialogue_resp.bheki_street_check.label: [STREET >= 2] "Ba-marshals ba gago ba nkolota go tšwa go tumano ya Berea. Hlakola di-plate tša ka mo go ba-hlodi ba Mokoena."
dialogue_resp.masibi_act2_back.label: "Karolo ye botse ya batho ba bararo."
dialogue_resp.masibi_act2_deed.label: [Present Evidence: Sovereign Pearl Trust Deed] "Ke na le pampiri ya beng ba thepa, Ma-Sibi. Reka boemo bja gago go tšwa go pampiri ya ka ya melato."
dialogue_resp.masibi_act2_exit.label: "O se ke wa namela Gulfstream yeo gona bjale, Councillor."
dialogue_resp.masibi_act2_trust.label: "Sovereign Pearl Holdings ke eng, gomme ke ka baka la eng Gulfstream e tletše peterole kua Hangar 7?"
dialogue_resp.masibi_act2_wire.label: [WIRE >= 2] "Mohlankedi wa gago wa ditšhelete o lebetše go phumola Dubai SWIFT mirror kua server ya lebatong la bo-28."
dialogue_resp.masibi_ask_grid.label: "Ke hobaneng ha Sub-Station 14 e dula e tima ha Pier 2 e theola thepa bosiu bo bohareng?"
dialogue_resp.masibi_dockets_check.label: [DOCKETS >= 2] "Mongodi wa hao o siile kemiso ya Sub-Station 14 override mochineng wa fax. Ke kopitsa nako ya ha boema-kepe bo tima."
dialogue_resp.masibi_exit.label: "Natefeloa ke moea o pholileng ha o ntse o le teng, Councillor."
dialogue_resp.masibi_fax_back.label: "Ke lebohile haholo, Councillor."
dialogue_resp.masibi_grid_back.label: "Tlhophiso e loketseng."
dialogue_resp.masibi_leverage_back.label: "Ke tla kenya retainer ena pokothong. Re tla bona ka dikoranta."
dialogue_resp.masibi_payoff_back.label: "Re tla bona gore ke mang yo a tlo namelago sefofane."
dialogue_resp.masibi_present_ledger.labe: [Present Evidence: Decoded Water-Tanker Ledger] "Mashome a mane a diphesente a Zululand Aqua-Logistics a ho trust ya lelapa la hao, Ma-Sibi."
dialogue_resp.masibi_swift_back.label: "Kgato ya bohlale."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_act2_exit.label: "Ke nako ya go feleletša se tseleng ya sefofane."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_act2_influence.lab: [INFLUENCE >= 2] "Sergeant tša gago tša TRT tše dingwe ga di gona sefofaneng seo, Titus. Ke sa tšwa go ba botša gore o ba tlogela gore ba be le molato Khomisheneng."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_act2_tarmac.label: "Ge o namela ditepisi tšeo, Titus, o tla ba motho yo a tšhabelago molao bophelo bja gago ka moka."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_bluff.label: "Ke mpa ke hlahloba lenane la ditlolo tsa molao, Brigadier. O tshohile ntho e nngwe tseleng ya N2?"
dialogue_resp.mokoena_exit.label: "Robala hantle, Brigadier. Hlokomela moo o hatang teng nakong ya ha motlakase o tima."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_influence_check.la: [INFLUENCE >= 2] "Internal Affairs ya Pretoria e se e na le kopi ya Docket #409. Kgaotsa ho hlahloba kapa re tla tjheswa ka bobedi."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_mutiny_back.label: "Tsela ya sefofane e bulegile. A re feleletšeng se."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_present_manifest.l: [Present Evidence: Berth 14 Manifest] "Ke na le lentswe la hao ho tape o laela tlhaselo ya Umgeni, Titus. Ntefele hore ke lahle kopi ena."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_shakedown_back.lab: "Re tla bona hore na mokitlane wa hao o tla nka nako e kae."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_standdown_back.lab: "Ho monate ho etsa kgwebo le taolo ya SAPS."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_threat_back.label: "Tshwara monahano oo, Titus."
dialogue_resp.nandi_ask_ambush.label: "Mpolelele gape ka ga go hlaselwa ga weighbridge ya N2. Ke mang a thuntšego?"
dialogue_resp.nandi_back_root.label: "A re boele go dikgetho tša rena."
dialogue_resp.nandi_dockets_back.label: "Se se mphololetše nako ya go lekola di-ledger. Ema gabotse."

dialogue_resp.nandi_leave_ambush.label: "Ke tla netefatša gore molaetša woo o a utlwala."

dialogue_resp.sparks_wire_check.label: [WIRE >= 2] "A re kopanyeng dipini tsa JTAG kahare ho Faraday cage pele baseband e pinga tora."

dialogue_resp.vdm_act2_exit.label: "Tšwela pele ka Khomishene, Colonel. Nna ke ya go tsoma."
dialogue_resp.vdm_act2_plan.label: "Re nyaka eng gore re thibele Sefofane sa ZS-900 gomme re ba feleletše ruri?"

dialogue_resp.vdm_exit.label: "Boloka lebati la tšhireletšo le tswaletšwe, Colonel. Ke batametše go itokiša."
dialogue_resp.vdm_motion_back.label: "A re šomišeng monyetla wo."
dialogue_resp.vdm_politics_back.label: "Gona re tla feta Upstairs ka moka."
dialogue_resp.vdm_present_both.label: [Present Evidence: Berth 14 Manifest] "Theeletša faele ye ya modumo, Colonel. Mokoena o laetše tlhaselo ya N2 ka boyena."
dialogue_resp.zuko_act2_exit.label: "Re tla bonana tseleng ya sefofane Hangar 7, Zuko."
dialogue_resp.zuko_act2_present_telemetr: [Present Evidence: Super-Lab Telemetry] "Nomoro e nngwe le e nngwe ya batch le tsela ya tanka di šetše di kopilwe ka ntle. Tloša sehlopha sa gago sa izinkabi gomme o lefe lekgetho la phetogo."

dialogue_resp.zuko_deal_back.label: "Re tla bona gore mosegare wa gare ga bošego o tliša eng."
dialogue_resp.zuko_exit.label: "Re tla rarolla taba ye ge convoy ya mosegare wa gare ga bošego e fihla, Zuko."
dialogue_resp.zuko_manifesto_back.label: "Re tla dira kgetho yeo Hangar 7."
dialogue_resp.zuko_philosophy.label: "O chefo metsi a toropo ho tsamaisa dikhemikhale, Zuko."
dialogue_resp.zuko_present_manifest.labe: [Present Evidence: Berth 14 Manifest] "Container MSCU-908114 e na le mohlala. Mpha karolo ya ka ya chelete ya thepa goba Hawks ba tla hlasela MV Southern Cross."

ending.ending_act2_reckoning.hook: KHAMPENI E FEDILE (KETSO 1 + KETSO 2): O phologile tšhimego ya motlakase, o utulotše sephiri sa Sovereign Pearl, gomme o tlišitše ba go se swarwe ba eThekwini-Gold pele ga toka.
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.p1: As Gulfstream ZS-900 turns onto the active taxiway, four unmarked Hawks interceptors and a High Court sheriff’s van block the nose gear. You step out into the blinding sodium glare holding the certified Sovereign Pearl Trust Deed and the Midlands super-lab batch logs.
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.p2: Brigadier Mokoena reaches for his holster, but seeing twenty DPCI rifles trained on the airstairs—and a live broadcast camera streaming directly to the Commission’s emergency feed—he slowly lowers his weapon. Councillor Ma-Sibi and Zuko Ndlovu are led down the wet stairs in steel cuffs.
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.p3: By morning, the KwaZulu-Natal High Court places Zululand Aqua-Logistics under judicial administration, and the northern township reservoirs open to full pressure for the first time in a year.

ending.ending_act2_reckoning.quote: "Lekga la mathomo ka morago ga mengwaga ye masomepedi, disirene tša mabone a matala di be di sa hlakole tsela bakeng sa bo-VIP—di be di ba swara ka diketane."
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.shift1.summ: Zuko Ndlovu, Councillor Ma-Sibi, and Brigadier Mokoena face 142 counts of racketeering, treasonous sabotage, and murder before a special High Court tribunal.
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.shift2.summ: Forensic teams seize R1.2 billion in offshore escrow and dismantle the Howick hydroponic precursor plant.
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.shift3.summ: Promoted to Major in the rebuilt DPCI Organised Crime Directorate, you and Constable Nandi take over the 13th Floor of Central Setheo sa Maphodisa.

ending.ending_act2_revolution.hook: KHAMPENI E FEDILE (KETSO 1 + KETSO 2): O thubile sindikate ya go tšea mmušo go tloga fase gomme wa bušetša bophelo bja eThekwini-Gold go batho ba yona.
ending.ending_act2_revolution.p1: Instead of waiting for slow court orders, you broadcast the Hangar 7 coordinates and the Sovereign Pearl escrow keys directly to Bra Bheki’s Queen Street marshals and the Northern Township strike committees.
ending.ending_act2_revolution.p2: Within thirty minutes, three hundred minibus taxis and forty hijacked municipal water tankers smash through the cargo apron perimeter fence, surrounding Gulfstream ZS-900 on the runway. Zuko’s mercenaries drop their rifles and flee into the sugarcane fields.
ending.ending_act2_revolution.p3: Before sunrise, the Lekgotla la Bosenyi’s R400 million liquid escrow is wired directly into community water cooperatives, and a convoy of freshly flushed tankers rolls into KwaMashu with sirens blaring in celebration.
ending.ending_act2_revolution.quote: "Ba utswitše meetse gomme ba re rekišetša komelelo. Bošego bja lehono re boetše re tšea ditereka, dipompi, le akhaonto ya panka."
ending.ending_act2_revolution.shift1.sum: The Northern Township Water Forum seizes permanent control of the municipal tanker fleet, ending the artificial drought overnight.
ending.ending_act2_revolution.shift2.sum: Stripped of both their Sehlopha sa Bosenyi protection and offshore slush funds, Ma-Sibi’s coalition resigns en masse amid citywide street celebrations.
ending.ending_act2_revolution.shift3.sum: Every minibus from Point Road to the Midlands carries your callsign on the rear window—the outlaw Hawk who gave the city back to its streets.

ending.ending_act2_syndicate_state.hook: KHAMPENI E FEDILE (KETSO 1 + KETSO 2): O fentše sehlopha se sengwe le se sengwe ka eThekwini-Gold gomme wa tšea setulo sa mmušo wa moriti.
ending.ending_act2_syndicate_state.p1: You stand alone in the rain at Hangar 7 with your thumb on the encrypted broadcast switch. Zuko Ndlovu looks at the High Court subpoena in your left hand and the Dubai flight plan in your right, then smiles and signs the transfer of Sovereign Pearl Holdings.
ending.ending_act2_syndicate_state.p2: At 00:05 AM, you call off the Hawks interceptors and watch Gulfstream ZS-900 climb into the storm clouds toward the Indian Ocean. Ten minutes later, Colonel van der Merwe receives a sanitized Tokomane ya Molato pinning the entire conspiracy on a dead deputy clerk.
ending.ending_act2_syndicate_state.p3: From the top floor of the Umhlanga Ridge glass tower, you watch Stage 6 plunge the city below into darkness—while your private turbines hum without a flicker.
ending.ending_act2_syndicate_state.quote: "Mmušo ga o we ge kgoši e namela sefofane. Di fo fetola disainetšha go pampiri ya thekgo."
ending.ending_act2_syndicate_state.shift: With Zuko, Ma-Sibi, and Mokoena exiled in Dubai, you assume 100% control of Sovereign Pearl Holdings, the Boema-kepe cranes, and the Midlands estate.
The State Capture Inquiry releases a toothless 900-page report recommending "administrative reforms" with zero high-profile convictions.
You own the judges, the taxi ranks, and the municipal tenders. In eThekwini-Gold, midnight now belongs to you.

ending.ending_act2_vanished.p1: Arriving at Hangar 7 without certified proof of either the Sovereign Pearl trust or the Midlands batch telemetry leaves you exposed on the open tarmac. When Stage 6 cuts the airport perimeter lights, Brigadier Mokoena’s sniper team pins your vehicle behind a cargo loader.
ending.ending_act2_vanished.p2: Gulfstream ZS-900 roars down the runway and lifts into the coastal clouds carrying every original Puku ya Ditšhelete and witness out of South African jurisdiction.
ending.ending_act2_vanished.p3: Three weeks later, the Commission of Inquiry closes its proceedings behind locked doors, sealing your uncorroborated testimony in the National Archives for fifty years.

ending.ending_captured.p1: Exhausted, broke, and boxed in by Operation Shanela roadblocks, your trail finally runs out in the rain-swept alleys behind Queen Street. When the grid drops to Stage 6, the streetlights die—and four unmarked TRT Volkswagen Golfs box you against the shuttered roller doors.
ending.ending_captured.p2: Brigadier Mokoena doesn’t read you your rights. He pulls Tokomane ya Molato #409 and the dead auditor’s phone from your coat pocket, checks the seal, and nods to Sergeant Dlamini.
ending.ending_captured.p3: By the time the morning commuters crowd the taxi rank, theMercury Arcade flat has been scrubbed Go Hlweka, and another anonymous dossier has vanished into the furnace of eThekwini-Gold.

ending.ending_kingpin.p1: The private elevator to The Glass House rises above the rusted container cranes into air-conditioned silence. Zuko Ndlovu pours two glasses of single malt while Brigadier Mokoena and Councillor Ma-Sibi’s Chief of Staff watch you lay the bloodstained original pages of Tokomane ya Molato #409 and the auditor’s decrypted drive onto the glass table.
ending.ending_kingpin.p2: "Logistics is about removing friction," Zuko says softly, looking out over the darkened city grid. "You proved more capable than Brigadier Mokoena’s entire regiment. Name your tariff."
ending.ending_kingpin.p3: You strike the match yourself. As the original forensic annexures curl into ash, your suspension is wiped from the SAPS mainframe, Constable Nandi’s name is cleared with a quiet medical pension, and your newly registered consulting firm is awarded 20% of the Zululand Aqua-Logistics pipeline.

ending.ending_kingpin.quote: "Go eThekwini-Gold, ga go na yo a fenyago motšhene. O a kgoboketšwa ka tlase ga ditankara, goba o reka setulo go baki ya go laola meetse."

ending.ending_vigilante.p1: When Stage 6 kills the Boema-kepe floodlights at midnight, Bra Bheki’s minibus convoy cuts its headlights and blocks the Pier 2 weighbridge. Fifteen heavily armed izinkabi step out from behind the rusting container stacks just as Brigadier Mokoena’s unmarked TRT vans escort the municipal water tankers onto Berth 14.
ending.ending_vigilante.p2: The firefight echoes across the Natal Port Channel for twenty minutes. Punctured chemical drums spill across the wet asphalt, catching a tracer round and sending a wall of orange flame forty metres into the humid night sky.
ending.ending_vigilante.p3: In the chaos, you breach the lead armoured command van, haul out two steel cases of Abasanta bearer Tšhelete ya Matsogong, and pull Constable Nandi into your getaway car before the port sirens even spin up.

ending.ending_whistleblower.p1: At 04:00 AM, Colonel Piet van der Merwe’s loyal Hawks task force seals the steel blast doors of the Old Bopolokelo bja Dingwalwa Phaposi ya ka Tlase. While Constable Nandi is smuggled onto a light aircraft bound for a witness-protection safe farm in the Drakensberg, you upload the decrypted Berth 14 audio and the audited Zululand Aqua-Logistics ledgers to every independent newsroom in the country.
ending.ending_whistleblower.p2: By sunrise, Brigadier Mokoena’s voice—ordering the execution of the municipal auditor and clearing the N2 weighbridge for Zuko’s chemical tankers—is playing on every taxi radio and morning news bulletin from Durban to Johannesburg.
ending.ending_whistleblower.p3: Outside City Hall, thousands of residents whose taps have been dry for months flood the streets, surrounding Councillor Ma-Sibi’s motorcade.

event.evt_act2_climax_tarmac.p1: Pula ya go thutha ya lebopong e itia konkereite ya Hangar 7 yeo e bonesitšwego. Di-turbine tša Rolls-Royce tša Gulfstream ZS-900 di lla kudu ge basepedi ba dithoto ba tsenya diphalete tša mafelelo tša dikoloto le diphuthelwana tša dipoloti ka gare.
event.evt_act2_climax_tarmac.p2: Kwa tlase ga ditepisi tša sefofane go eme baagi ba bararo ba go thopša ga eThekwini-Gold: Zuko Ndlovu a apere kobo ya gagwe ya go hloka lethetho, Councillor Ma-Sibi a swere paseporoto ya gagwe ya dipoloti, le Brigadier Mokoena a swere sethunya sa gagwe a lebeletše tarmac yeo e kolobeditšwego ke pula.
event.evt_act2_climax_tarmac.p3: "Metšotso e mehlano go fihla ge re phaphama, Warrant Officer," Zuko o goeletša ka godimo ga modumo wa jet. "Iketsetše phetho ya gore ke naga ya mohuta mang yeo o tlago tsoga o e bona gosasa."

event.evt_act2_lab_telemetry.p2: Se se phala tšohle, dipampiri tša dithoto di bontšha gore ditone tše 1.8 tša kristale yeo e feditšwego di tsentšwe ka gare ga diphalete tša di-citrus tša go ya moseja, tšeo di lebanego Hangar 7 kwa King Shaka International Airport bošegong bjo.

event.evt_act2_trust_unmasked.p2: Ke yeo ka ntsho le tšhweu: Zuko Ndlovu (45%), Councillor Ma-Sibi (30%), le Brigadier Titus Mokoena (25%)—gotee le kharter ya Gulfstream G550 (Flight ZS-900) yeo e emetšego King Shaka Hangar 7 le dipampiri tša setsha sa Lot 44 ka Midlands.

event.evt_climax_berth14.p1: Pula e na ka matla go bapa le Natal Port Channel ge dikhrane tša Pier 2 di tšwelela ka gare ga phoka. Ka fase ga Berth 14, ditankara tše tharo tša meetse di letile kgauswi le dikontheinara tša Zuko Ndlovu, di dikaganyeditšwe ke di-Nyalas tša TRT tša Brigadier Mokoena.
event.evt_climax_berth14.p2: Nako ya gago e fedile. Go sa šetšwe gore o fihlile mo ka di-ledger tša tšhelete, di-voice note, goba matla a gago, o na le monyetla o tee wa go dira sephetho pele ga ge convoy e tloga go ya tseleng ya N2.

event.evt_climax_berth14.title: Midnight at Berth 14: The Final Play
event.evt_composure_breakdown.p1: Di-atla tša gago ga di kgaotše go thothomela. Gare ga mosi wa jenereithara ya disela, go lla ga di-sirene kua Queen Street, le dikgwedi tše tshela o itšhireletša, pono ya gago e fetoga static.
event.evt_composure_breakdown.p2: O wela fase ka gare ga setaiere sa samente se se kolobile sa Mercury Arcade, o lwa go hema. Ge o sa iketlele bjale, o tla dira phošo ya go bolaya.
event.evt_composure_breakdown.speaker: Internal Monologue
event.evt_composure_breakdown.title: Blackout Paranoia: Nervous Collapse
event.evt_docket_decoded.p1: O ala matlakala a a tletšego madi a Docket #409 godimo ga tafola ya gago ka fase ga lebone. Dinomoro di feleletša di kwagala gabotse.
event.evt_docket_decoded.p2: "Zululand Aqua-Logistics" e rometše City Hall bili ya R400 million bakeng sa go fetišetša meetse a tšhoganetšo ditoropong tša leboa. Efela di-log tša GPS di laetša gore ditankara tša masepala ga se tša ya ditoropong tšeo—di kgweetseditšwe go tloga Pier 2 Cold Storage go ya di-warehouse tša intasteri ka ntle ga toropo, di šireleditšwe ke di-van tša TRT tša Brigadier Mokoena.
event.evt_docket_decoded.p3: Councillor Ma-Sibi ga a utswe tšhelete ya meetse fela. Ditankara tša gagwe di rwala dikhemikhale tša go dira methamphetamine tša Zuko Ndlovu.
event.evt_docket_decoded.title: The Water-Tanker Pipeline

event.evt_morning_cable_theft.p1: Mosi o moso o motenya o rotogela go tšwa go substation ya Umgeni ge go sa. Syndicate ya go utswa kopa e phuthulotše dikgwele tše tharo tša motlakase o mokaalo bošego, gomme ya tsenya sephethephethe sa CBD ka gare ga mathata.
event.evt_morning_cable_theft.p2: Ba-hlahli ba ditsela ba Bra Bheki ba tšere di-intersection ka di-whistle le di-sjambok, ge di-founo tša SAPS di le gare ga sephethephethe dikhilomithara tše pedi go tšwa moo.

event.evt_morning_cable_theft.title: Morning Dispatch: Umgeni Feeder Cable Stripped
event.evt_morning_masibi_wire.p1: Ge ditekesi tša mesong di thoma go lla go bapa le Queen Street, founo ya gago ya burner e thothomela ka molaetša wa Signal wo o sa ngwalwago go tšwa go 4th Floor ya City Hall.
event.evt_morning_masibi_wire.p2: "Warrant Officer. Re a tseba gore Constable Nandi o go tlišeditše dipampiri tša Mandla Sithole. Ga go motho City Hall yo a nyakago lebitla le lengwe. Diegiša audit ya gago lehono, gomme retainer ya R800 ya boeletši ya masepala e tla lahlelwa ka gare ga poso ya gago pele ga iri e fela."

event.evt_morning_masibi_wire.title: Encrypted Wire: The 4th-Floor Olive Branch
event.evt_morning_port_tipoff.p1: Lenaka le lla go putla mohlaka wa boemakepe ge sekepe sa dikhontheinara sa MV Southern Cross se tloga boemakepe. Radio ya gago ya sephiri e lla ka lentšu la Colonel van der Merwe.
event.evt_morning_port_tipoff.p2: "Theetša gabotse. Meropa ya dikhemikhale ya Zuko Ndlovu e arolwa go Berth 14 bošego bjo, gomme dikoloi tša TRT tša Mokoena di šetše di emetše go weighbridge. Enetša gore o swere Decoded Tanker Ledger goba Berth 14 Manifest pele ga ge nako e itia gare ga bošego."

event.evt_morning_port_tipoff.title: Molaetša wa Potlako: MV Southern Cross e emiša Berth 14
event.evt_nandi_critical.p1: Nandi o a thothomela kudu ka fase ga paba yeo e tletšego mofufutšo. Leeba la kgaro ya lerumo le le lego kgauswi le dikgopo tša gagwe le fetogile mmala wa pherese o moso o o tšhošago, gomme o a hlapahlapela magareng ga go tseba le go se tsebe.
event.evt_nandi_critical.p2: Ge o ka mo iša Addington goba Inkosi Albert Luthuli Hospital, rejistara ya dikgaro tša lerumo e tla tsebiša Brigadier Mokoena mo nakong ya metsotso ye masomepedi.

event.evt_phone_decrypted.p1: Sparks o ntšha mosi wa vape ge founo ya mofu e feleletša e butšwe. Ka gare ga foldara ya sephiri go na le rekoto ya modumo le manifest ya go romela dithoto ya bošego bja lehono.
event.evt_phone_decrypted.p2: Mo rekoting, lentswe la Brigadier Mokoena le a kwagala: "Hlatswa weighbridge ya N2 gare ga bošego. Kontheinara ya Zuko e tla fihla Berth 14, gomme mang le mang wa Hawks yo a ka nyakago go tseba o tla bolokwa ka gare ga moepo."

event.evt_phone_decrypted.title: Voice Note from Berth 14
event.evt_shanela_roadblock.p1: Modumo wa disirene o kwagala magareng ga meago ye metelele. Mabone a magolo le dikhono tša namune di tswaletše ditsela tša CBD ge SAPS le Metro Police ba hloma thibelo ya go nyaka-nyaka ka matla.
event.evt_shanela_roadblock.p2: Minibasi ye nngwe le ye nngwe, baesekele ya courier, le mosepedi ba a hlahlobiwa bakeng sa dithunya tšeo di se nago dilaesense le ditokomane tšeo di utswitšwego.

event.evt_trt_safehouse_raid.p2: Sethunya se itia kgoro ya gago ya tshipi. "Hawks Warrant Officer! Bula kgoro goba re tla e thunya! Brigadier Mokoena o nyaka docket ya gagwe!"

intro.pitch: Dikgweding tše tshela tše di fetilego, Brigadier Titus Mokoena o go pharile molato wa maaka a boloka beche ya gago ya Hawks. Bošegong bjo, nakong ya kgaotšo ya mohlagase ya Stage 4 lebopong, molekane wa gago wa pele o tsena ka phaphošing ya gago ya Mercury Arcade a tšwa madi ka ntlha ya nthoba sethunya—a swere puku ya madi yeo e tswalanyago dithendara tša dilerori tša meetse tša R400m tša City Hall thwii le sehlopha sa dihlare-tagi sa Abasanta.
intro.pitch_story2: Tshenyo ya maano ya go tšweletša mohlagase ya Eskom go gapeletša dithendara tša tšhoganetšo tša diesel, tšeo di thekgwago ke bo-ramakgwebo ba tšhireletšo le matona a bomenetši. Monyakišiši wa SIU Kagiso "Bra K" Molefe o swanetše go tsena ka meleteng e tseneletšego ya meepo ya Johannesburg le dintlong tša Sandton pele marangrang a wela fase.
intro.pitch_story3: Ditumelelo tša go se ngwadišwe tša go epa ditaemane fase ga lewatle, go fetišetšwa ga dibetša mellwaneng, le bahlabani ba dikepe tša sephiri bao ba hlatswago tšhelete ya maatla go ba maswika a diphapano tša boditšhabatšhaba lebopong la Atlantic la go aparetswe ke mouwane la Port Nolloth le Richtersveld.
intro.pitch_story4: Kopano ya moriti ya balaodi ba maphodisa a selete, dihlopha tše di kopanego tša disenyi tša Cape Flats, le bo-ramakgwebo ba histori ba Winelands bao ba hlomago mašole a tšhireletšo ya sephiri go laola ekonomi ya bošego le maemelakepe a go romela ntle. Mofepi wa kgale wa Sehlopha sa go Lwantšha Digwera Leila Hendricks o nyakišiša go tloga Camps Bay go fihla mafelong a beine a Stellenbosch.
intro.pitch_story5: Go Wela fase ka Botlalo ga Marangrang a Mohlagase a Kgato ya 8 go ralala le diprofense ka moka tše senyane. Sehlopha se Kopanego sa Hawks se kopanya maswika a bohlokwa a mane a selete a dinyakišišo go hlasela kopano ya godimo ya Sovereign Octagon go la Drakensberg pele temokrasi e phumolwa go ya go ile.
intro.slot_no_data: Ga go na tshedimošo ya nyakišišo ye e rekotilwego sekgobeng se.

mission.classified_exhibits_header: Bohlatse bja Sephiri le Ditlabelo tša Mmaraka o Moso:
mission.faq_q1_body: Cycle ke Letšatši le 1 Papading (šifi ya diiri tše 24). Ga go na tekanyo ye e beilwego ya go swana le matšatši a 50 goba 100. Go e na le moo, o kitima kgahlanong le Diorogo tša Ditšhošetšo tšeo di Welago Fase (go swana le go phenkgola ga Brigadier Mokoena dikarolong tše 6). Nyakišišo ya ka mehla e tšea dicycle tše 3 go ya go tše 6 go Karolo 1 le tše 4 go ya go tše 8 go Karolo 2.
mission.faq_q1_title: 1. Na "Cycle" ke eng gona go na le tše kae?
mission.faq_q2_body: Mesong e mengwe le e mengwe, o kuka ditaese tše 3 go ya go tše 5 KA MOKA motseng ka bophara go ya ka Boitshepo bja gago (80%+ = ditaese tše 5, 40–79% = ditaese tše 4, <40% = ditaese tše 3). GA O kuke ditaese lefelong le lengwe le le lengwe! O kgetha dikgato tše bohlokwa tše 3 go ya go tše 5 mmepeng go tsenya matsapa a gago a letšatši.
mission.faq_q2_title: 2. Ke hwetša ditaese tše kae? Na ke kuka ditaese lefelong le lengwe le le lengwe?
mission.faq_q3_body:
Go kgotla Fetsa Cycle go feditše šifi ya gago le go iša pele mesong ya go latela:
• Diorogo tša Ditšhošetšo di a tšwela pele (+1 karolo diorogong tše khubedu).
• Kgaotšo ya mohlagase e a dikologa (Stage 2 → 4 → 6 → 2).
• Molaetša wa Sephiri wa Masa o a fihla ka dintlha tše mpsha tša kanegelo.
• O kuka ditaese tše mpsha gosasa mesong.
mission.faq_q3_title: 3. Go direga eng ge ke kgotla "Fetsa Cycle / Robala"?
mission.faq_q4_body: Tereye ya ka tlase e bontšha "X tšeo di lego gona • Y tšeo di šomišitšwego". Ditaese tšeo di šomišitšwego di fetoga go ba tše tsothwana tša go fifala gomme di bontšha leswao la [E ŠOMIŠITŠWE]. Ditaese tšeo di lego gona di kganya kudu ka dipalo goba marothodi a gauta.
mission.faq_q4_title: 4. Ke tseba bjang gore ke ditaese dife tšeo di šomišitšwego le tšeo di lego gona?
mission.faq_q5_body: Ee! Ge eba phenkgolo ya Brigadier Mokoena e fihla go 6/6, phaphoši ya gago e a hlaselwa gomme nyakišišo e fela ka go golegwa. Ge eba go tšwa madi ga Constable Nandi go fihla go 4/4 pele o mo alafa, o hlokofala sa ruri phaphošing ya gago (-30% Boitshepo). Ge eba Boitshepo bja gago bo fihla go 0%, o thoma Blackout Paranoia!
mission.faq_q5_title: 5. Na moanegwa wa ka a ka hlokofala goba a baka Game Over?
mission.how_to_win_act1: Hlalosa Docket #409 (phaphošing ya Mercury Arcade) goba o pšhatle Auditor's Handset (Golden Dragon). Ge o na le efe kapa efe, Pier 2 le Old Archive di tla bulega, tša go dumelela go thoma Berth 14 Finale le go tsena go Act 2!

pnode.scene_1_wakeup.p1: Ka iri ya bobedi ya masa, grid ya masepala e a hwa ka modumo o mogolo wa tshipi go tšwa seteišeneng sa motlakase kwa Queen Street. Fene ya siling e a ema. Ka ntle ga mafesetere a gago, pula ya lebopo e a thunya marulelong a tshipi ya Mercury Arcade, e bonesitšwe fela ke lesedi la jenereithara ya disela ya spaza shop ka mola tselaneng.
pnode.scene_1_wakeup.p2: Desking ya gago go na le pottolo ya cane spirits ya go se felele le lengwalo la go emišwa mošomong leo le saenilwego ke Brigadier Titus Mokoena dikgwedi tše tshela tše di fetilego.
pnode.scene_1_wakeup.p3: Gomme go tla modumo—e sego wa tshipi ya kgoro ya fase, eupša ke go kokota ga bararo ga go tšhoša, go kolobile kgorong ya gago ya tshipi ya Trellidor godimo ga tsela ya go tšhabela mollo. Pele o fihlelela 9mm Parabellum ka tlase ga mpeto wa gago, gopola gore o be o le mang pele Mokoena a boloka mošomo wa gago:
pnode.scene_2_the_door.p1: O lokiša Z88 ya gago gomme o ema ka thoko ga kgoro. Ka lesoba la kgoro, lebone la tšhoganyetšo le a phadima godimo ga baki ya SAPS ya go koloba.
pnode.scene_2_the_door.p2: Ke Constable Nandi—roki a nnoši seteisheneng yo a ganne go saena affidavit ya maaka ya Mokoena kgahlanong le wena. O swere dikgopo tša gagwe tša nngele, madi a maso a tšwa magareng ga menwana ya gagwe, a swere dokeiti ya manila ya boso le smartphone ya go phatloga ka tlase ga letsogo la gagwe.
pnode.scene_2_the_door.p3: "Warrant..." o a hema, mahlo a gagwe a lebelela moriti wa ditepisi. "Bula kgoro. Hle. Dibakkie tša TRT tša Mokoena di sa tšwa go feta thekisi. Ge transponder ya radio ya ka e sa šoma, ba dikhilomithara tše pedi ka morago ga ka."
pnode.scene_2_the_door.role: SAPS Maphodisa a Terene ya Lebelo le Mmila o Mogolo (Yo a kilego a ba Moswa wa Gago)
pnode.scene_3_the_ambush.p1: O gatelela thaole ya go hlweka ka thoko ga gagwe. 9mm hollow-point e mo thuntše kgauswi le dikgopo—e tsene ka mo go lekanego gore a tšwe madi, e kotsi kudu go rokwa sepetlele sa mmušo moo bakwaledi ba maphodisa ba ngwalago motho yo mongwe le yo mongwe wa go thuntšhwa.
pnode.scene_3_the_ambush.p2: Nandi o go fa Dokeiti #409 le smartphone ya madi. "Re arabetše go utswiwa ga tšhelete kwa N2 south ramp gare ga bošego. Bakkie ya G4S e thuthupeditšwe ka C4, Warrant. Eupša go be go se na tšhelete ka gare."
pnode.scene_3_the_ambush.p3: O mitša ka thata, a a thothomela. "Go be go na le mohlahlobi wa masepala yo a hwilego a tlemilwe ka diketane, le puku ye. Dimilione tše nne tša Ranta ka dithendara tša ditankara tša meetse di rometšwe ka ofising ya Councillor Ma-Sibi go ya kwa di-warehouse tša Zuko Ndlovu. Ge molekane wa ka a leka go e ngwala, Brigadier Mokoena o fihlile ka bakkie ya TRT ya go se be le nomoro... gomme a mo thunya sehuba."
pnode.scene_4_the_squeeze.p1: Nandi o idibala godimo ga sofa ya gago ge seedi sa masa se tsena ka difensetereng. Ka ntle, ditekesi tša mathomo di thoma go letsa dinaka tša tšona Queen Street.
pnode.scene_4_the_squeeze.p2: O na le mathata a mabedi a a go kitimago: ntho ya Nandi ya sethunya e tla bola mo matšatšing a mane ge o sa lefe ngaka ya sephiring (R1,500), mme dihlopha tša TRT tša Brigadier Mokoena di hlakola kgaolo ka kgaolo.
pnode.scene_4_the_squeeze.p3: Diatleng tša gago go na le bohlatse bjo bo kgokaganyago City Hall, SAPS Organized Crime, le Abasanta Cartel. Ditaese tša gago tša letšatši di loketše tafoleng.

slot.act_clone_transponder.clean: O tsentše scanner sa SAPS se o se kopilego ka pokothong—bjale o kgona go kwa le go efoga di-roadblock tšohle ka nako ya nnete.
slot.act_clone_transponder.compromised: Scanner sa radio se se tletšego ka di-static se šoma gabotse go go thuša go tšwa gare ga maphodisa.
slot.act_clone_transponder.desc: Aga sediriši sa go thopa di-frequency go latela diphatlalatšo tša TRT le go efoga di-roadblock tša SAPS.
slot.act_clone_transponder.failure: O fišitše board ya soldering gomme wa lahlegelwa ke R500 ya dikarolo tša go šomiša.
slot.act_clone_transponder.title: Kopi ya Ma-frequency a Radio ya SAPS
slot.act_crack_phone.clean: Sparks o thuba karolo ya tšhireletšo. Di-voice note tša go tšwa Pier 2 di thoma go dounlouda.
slot.act_crack_phone.compromised: Tšhireletšo e romela temošo ya go phumola data, eupša Sparks o swere firewall.
slot.act_crack_phone.desc: Feta tšhireletšo ya biometric ya selefouno ya mohlahlobi yo a hwilego.
slot.act_crack_phone.failure: Temosho ya tšhireletšo e tsebiša ba-cyber-cleaners ba Abasanta pele Sparks a ntšha thapo.
slot.act_crack_phone.title: Thuba Selefouno ya Mohlahlobi
slot.act_handover_dockets.clean: Van der Merwe o lotlela faele ka gare ga sefe ya tshipi. Hawks ba thoma dosiye ya semmušo.
slot.act_handover_dockets.compromised: Van der Merwe o go lemoša gore Mokoena o na le di-mole ka gare ga di-archive tša Hawks.
slot.act_handover_dockets.desc: Neela dikhophi tše di netefaditšwego tša Docket #409 go banyakišiši ba Hawks ba ba botegago.
slot.act_handover_dockets.failure: Van der Merwe o ile raid; o tlogela ditokumente le sergeant wa tafoleng yo a tšhogilego.
slot.act_handover_dockets.title: Fa Colonel van der Merwe pego
slot.act_masibi_deal.clean: Chief of Staff ya Ma-Sibi o go romela R5,000 ya go thola gomme o go fa tsela ya go fihlelela phapoši ya taolo ya grid ya masepala.
slot.act_masibi_deal.compromised: Chief of Staff o dumela go khutša ga nakwana, o go bula tsela ya go fihlelela grid ya masepala.
slot.act_masibi_deal.desc: Iphe go fihla puku ya mohlahlobi pele ga khetho ya masepala bakeng sa tšhireletšo ya City Hall le go laola grid.
slot.act_masibi_deal.failure: Bahlokomedi ba mayoral VIP ba go lahlela ka ntle ga suite ya lebatong la bone gomme ba tsebiša Central Precinct.
slot.act_masibi_deal.title: Efa Ma-Sibi Tlhagišo ya Kgwebišano
slot.act_rank_muscle.clean: Bakhayifi ba mekhukhu ba lefa ntle le go ntšha dibetša. Bra Bheki o dumela ka tlhompho.
slot.act_rank_muscle.compromised: O otlwa ka wrench legetleng nakong ya ntwa, eupša o sepela le tšhelete.
slot.act_rank_muscle.desc: Hlakodiša bakhayifi ba mekhukhu kgauswi le tsela ya Umgeni bakeng sa Bra Bheki.
slot.act_rank_muscle.failure: Go thuntšwe kgauswi le kgoro ya ranke. Disirene tša maphodisa a Metro di a lla kgole.
slot.act_rank_muscle.title: Gapeletša Ditheko tša Tsela
slot.act_recon_berth14.clean: Dinepe tše di hlakilego tša Mokoena a thekga seatla le mohlokomedi wa di-dock wa Zuko.
slot.act_recon_berth14.compromised: Bahlokomedi ba mawatleng ba bone seetša sa gago sa flashlight; o tšhabela ka gare ga mekgobo ya dikhonteina.
slot.act_recon_berth14.desc: Tšea dinepe tša meropa ya dikhemikhale tšeo di rwalelwago ka gare ga ditankara tša masepala.
slot.act_recon_berth14.failure: Bahlokomedi ba khathalele ba go kgaoletše ka morago ga folkhlifte; o pholoxile ka tšhukudu go tšwa kgorong.
slot.act_recon_berth14.title: Go hlohlomiša Berth 14 Container Drop
slot.act_rest_safehouse.clean: O hwekiša dibante tša gagwe gomme o a phomola. Mpshiko wa Nandi o a fokotšega.
slot.act_rest_safehouse.compromised: Phomolo e kgaotšwa ke disirene tša maphodisa tšeo di kwagalago go theoša Queen Street.
slot.act_rest_safehouse.desc: Fodiša maikutlo. Reka gauze ya bongaka go diegiša nako ya leeba la Nandi.
slot.act_rest_safehouse.failure: Boroko bjo bo sa kgahlišego bjo bo tletšego ditoro tše mpe ka ga dihlopha tša TRT tša Mokoena.
slot.act_rest_safehouse.title: Phomola le go Alafa Nandi
slot.act_taxi_intel.clean: Bakhayifi ba tlatša di-radio ka ditsela tša Mokoena tša go leta.
slot.act_taxi_intel.compromised: Tshedimošo ya go phatlalala go tšwa go bakhayifi bao ba bonnego seripa sa sehlopha sa dikoloi.
slot.act_taxi_intel.desc: Lefa bo-marshale ba ranke go latela dibaki tša TRT tšeo di se nago maswao le di-roadblock.
slot.act_taxi_intel.failure: O lefa tshedimošo yeo e lego ya go se šome, e le ya go bolela fela ka tavern.
slot.act_taxi_intel.title: Šomiša Netweke ya Bakhayifi
slot.act_trigger_berth14_finale.clean: O itokišetša ka godimo ga Berth 14 ge ditankara tša meetse tša masepala di fihla kgauswi le khrane ya Zuko.
slot.act_trigger_berth14_finale.compromi: O tšwa ka gare ga legora la perimeter ka gare ga pula yeo e nelego ge di-enjene tša convoy di thoma go duma.
slot.act_trigger_berth14_finale.desc: Tšea kgato bošego bjo bo magareng go thopa ditankara go phethagatša go lathwa ga Vigilante goba go boledišana ka kwano ya Kingpin kwa The Glass House.
slot.act_trigger_berth14_finale.failure: Dimpša tša tšhireletšo ya boemakepe di go gapeletša go boela morago; nako ya go romela e kgauswi le go fela.
slot.act_trigger_berth14_finale.title: [FINALE] Lebana le Convoy ya Berth 14
slot.act_trigger_whistleblower_finale.cl: Uplink ya Van der Merwe e kgokaganya le newsroom ya The Daily Veld ge nako e itia gare ga bošego kwa Berth 14.
slot.act_trigger_whistleblower_finale.co: Uplink e šoma le ge go na le di-jammer tša TRT ka ntle ga kgoro ya mahlodi.
slot.act_trigger_whistleblower_finale.de: Tswalela dikgoro tša polokelo gomme o romele bohlatse bja Berth 14 go The Daily Veld go thoma Act 1 Climax.
slot.act_trigger_whistleblower_finale.fa: Static e senya phatlalatšo—nako ya gare ga bošego kwa Berth 14 e kgauswi le go fela.
slot.act_trigger_whistleblower_finale.ti: [FINALE] Thoma Phatlalatšo ya Bosetšhaba le go Ntšha Hlatse
slot.slot_act2_finale_citrus.clean: O thuba dikgoro tša packhouse mme o tšea puku ya dipalo—o gapeletša Zuko le Mokoena go kitimela Hangar 7!
slot.slot_act2_finale_citrus.compromised: Ka gare ga thunya ya go tia o hwetša vats tša synthesis ge convoy ya syndicate e kitimela King Shaka Airport!
slot.slot_act2_finale_citrus.desc: Etapele balebedi ba setšhaba goba sehlopha sa Hawks ka go lebanya Packhouse B pele bohlatse bo ka fišwa.
slot.slot_act2_finale_citrus.failure: Packhouse e tuka ka malakabe, e goga thulano ya mafelelo mo King Shaka Hangar 7!
slot.slot_act2_finale_citrus.title: [FINALE] Hlasela Midlands Super-Lab
slot.slot_act2_finale_tarmac.clean: Mabone a gago a kgantsha leotwana la pele la Gulfstream—o thibela tsela ya go fofa bakeng sa kahlolo ya mafelelo!
slot.slot_act2_finale_tarmac.compromised: O thula thibelo ya Hangar 7 ge di-turbine tsa sefofane di thoma go dikologa!
slot.slot_act2_finale_tarmac.desc: Kgweetsa o tsene mo tarmac e e kolobileng ke pula ge Zuko Ndlovu, Councillor Ma-Sibi, le Brigadier Mokoena ba namela Gulfstream.
slot.slot_act2_finale_tarmac.failure: O thunywa ke balebedi ba Mokoena, o thelela o tsena mo tarmac ge ditepisi tsa go namela di thoma go hwelela!
slot.slot_act2_finale_tarmac.title: [FINALE] Thibela Sefofane ZS-900 kwa Hangar 7
slot.slot_breach_ridge_server.clean: Thubo ya go hlweka. O kopitša ditifikeiti tša DIFC Dubai pele firewall ya tšhireletšo ya sephiring e arabela.
slot.slot_breach_ridge_server.compromise: O ntšha seripa sa rejistara, eupša alamo ya sephiring e tsebisha MAC address ya gago go sehlopha sa semolao (+1 Contempt Warrant).
slot.slot_breach_ridge_server.desc: Tsena ka gare ga server ya polokelo ya tšhelete ya sephiring mo lebatong la bo-28 go latela Sovereign Pearl offshore shell trust.
slot.slot_breach_ridge_server.failure: Diphaphi tša biometrics di tswalega ka lebelo. O tšhaba ka setepisi sa bašomi ge balebedi ba tšhireletšo ba hlakola lobby.
slot.slot_breach_ridge_server.title: Thuba Server ya Fiduciary Escrow
slot.slot_extract_tanker_gps.clean: Ka balebedi ba Bra Bheki ba lebeletše, o ntšha dikhordinete tša tsela ya Howick tšeo di sa senyegago (+2 Lab Telemetry).
slot.slot_extract_tanker_gps.compromised: O ntšha module ya GPS, eupša molebedi wa cartel godimo ga thaba o bona moriti wa gago (+1 Hit Squad).
slot.slot_extract_tanker_gps.desc: Bula telemetry unit ya dashboard ya tanker ya masepala yeo e thopilwego go latela dikema tša yona tša bošego mo Midlands.
slot.slot_extract_tanker_gps.failure: Wiring ya ignition e thunya malakabe diatleng tša gago, e goga balebedi ba depot ba ba nago le dibetša.
slot.slot_extract_tanker_gps.title: Ntšha Black-Box GPS go Tanker #114
slot.slot_infiltrate_packhouse.clean: Ka tlase ga leswiswi o tšea dinepe tša mola wa synthesis ka moka mme o tšea R900 ya tšhelete ya pampiri go tšwa ka safe ya foreman.
slot.slot_infiltrate_packhouse.compromis: O tšea dinomoro tša batch, eupša mabone a go tšhoša a tuka ge dimpša tša Rottweiler di fihla lepokising.
slot.slot_infiltrate_packhouse.desc: Feta dimpša tša tšhireletšo go tšea dinepe tša ditankere tša masepala tšeo di pompago precursor ka packhouse ya citrus. Stage 6 e tima lepokisi la motlakase (+2).
slot.slot_infiltrate_packhouse.failure: Bahlankedi ba sephiring ba thunya ka dibetša tša R5 go tšwa tora ya go lebelela. O tšhaba ka tsela ya meetse o kolobile ka dikhemikhale.
slot.slot_infiltrate_packhouse.title: Thuba Packhouse B Synthesis Vats
slot.slot_rally_civic_marshals.clean: Makhura a go swa le dithibelo tša ditekesi di tswalela ditsela tša ka leboa—banna ba Zuko ba gapeletšega go boela morago (-2 Hit Squad).
slot.slot_rally_civic_marshals.compromis: Balebedi ba setšhaba ba fapogela sephethephethe go dikologa ntlo ya gago ya tšhireletšo (-1 Hit Squad).
slot.slot_rally_civic_marshals.desc: Fa tšhelete balebedi ba kgaolo ya meetse go bea dithibelo tša setšhaba tšeo di diegišago dihlopha tša polao tša cartel.
slot.slot_rally_civic_marshals.failure: SAPS Nyalas di gaša banyenyefatši ba setšhaba ka stun grenades pele dithibelo di ka tiišwa.
slot.slot_rally_civic_marshals.title: Hlopha le Komiti ya Setšhaba (R400)
slot.slot_recess_debrief.clean: Constable Nandi—yo a sepelago ka dikrutši—o hlahloba nako ya gago godimo ga tee ya rooibos (+25% Composure, -1 Contempt).
slot.slot_recess_debrief.compromised: Diiri tše pedi tša boroko bjo bo sa kgaotšego ka morago ga galase ya go thibela dikolo tša sethunya di bušetša tlhokomelo ya gago (+15% Composure).
slot.slot_recess_debrief.desc: Nwa kofi o hwelele dintho ka phapoši ya tšhireletšo ya Hawks ka tlase ga Courtroom A go tiiša methapo ya gago.
slot.slot_recess_debrief.failure: Babegaditaba ba kokota menyako ya phapoši bošego bjohle, o sa khutšago gannyane (+5% Composure).
slot.slot_recess_debrief.title: Debrief ya Phapoši ya Tšhireletšo ya Bohlatse (R300)
slot.slot_sabotage_transponder.clean: O tsenya phošo ya maaka ya mollo wa enjene ka khomphutara ya ZS-900, o diegiša go tloga (-1 Flight Countdown, -1 Hit Squad).
slot.slot_sabotage_transponder.compromis: Air Traffic Control e thibela sefofane sa charter mo tseleng ya go ya go fofa (-1 Flight Countdown).
slot.slot_sabotage_transponder.desc: Feta radar ya hangar go thibela leeto la Zuko la Dubai. Stage 6 e tima radar ya tarmac (+2).
slot.slot_sabotage_transponder.failure: Ba-thunya-ka-thunya ba SAPS TRT ba marulelong a hangar ba bone kgokagano ya gago ya laser go putla tarmac e e kolobileng.
slot.slot_sabotage_transponder.title: Tswalela Gulfstream ZS-900 Avionics
slot.slot_shakedown_consultant.clean: O go fa chip ya casino ya platinum le R1,100 ya tšhelete ya pampiri godimo ga tafola ya marble, a holofetša go diegiša warrant ya contempt.
slot.slot_shakedown_consultant.compromis: O lefa R650 ya gagwe go thibela leina la gagwe go tšwa, le ge molebedi wa gagwe a tšea dinepe tša dipoleiti tša gago.
slot.slot_shakedown_consultant.desc: Kgaoletša ramolao wa Councillor Ma-Sibi wa tšhelete ya offshore godimo ga scotch mme o nyake tšhelete ya go mo homotša.
slot.slot_shakedown_consultant.failure: O go sega ka sefahlego mme o bitša molaodi wa tšhireletšo wa Commission go bega tšhošetšo ya bohlatse.
slot.slot_shakedown_consultant.title: Gateletša Consultant ya Tender mo Sky-Bar
slot.slot_subpoena_bank_records.clean: Moahlodi Khumalo o saena taelo ya kgoro ya tsheko. Ofisiri ya panka e romela wire transfers mo go sa fetego iri (+2 Trust, -1 Contempt).
slot.slot_subpoena_bank_records.compromi: Ramolao wa tshireletšo o fa dikgopelo tše tharo tša tšhoganetšo, eupša o hwetša letlakala la go saena la motheo (+1 Trust).
slot.slot_subpoena_bank_records.desc: Šoma le baetapele ba bohlatse ba Colonel van der Merwe go gapeletša dipanka go utolla Sovereign Pearl Holdings.
slot.slot_subpoena_bank_records.failure: Ramolao wa Mokoena o go latofatša ka go hlama bohlatse mo setulong sa bohlatse (+1 Contempt Warrant).
slot.slot_subpoena_bank_records.title: Fela Section 205 Offshore Subpoena

tutorial.step1.badge: KGATO YA 1 GO TŠA 6 // PARA YA TLASE LE MOELETŠI
tutorial.step1.bullet1: Kgotla letaese lefe goba lefe godimo ga tereye ya tlase go le swara—Sekgoba se sengwe le se sengwe sa Tiro se bontšha palo ya gago e fetotšwego (Tala 6+, Serolane 4–5, Hubedu 1–3).
tutorial.step1.bullet2: Ga o na nnete ka seo o swanetšego go se dira morago? Latela "Moeletši wa Maano" go Phanele ya Ntsogo goba o lebelele dibetšhe tša "★ Kgothaleditšwe".
tutorial.step1.bullet3: Ge o feletšwe ke mataese a letšatši, kgotla "Fetša Modikologo / Robala →" go tšwela pele gosasa.
tutorial.step1.desc: Ge go sa tšwa go sa (Letšatši le lengwe le le lengwe), monyakišiši wa gago o foša taese tše 3 go ya go 5 tša mahlakore a tshelelago go ya ka Kgotlelelo ya Monagano ya bjale (80–100% = taese tše 5, 40–79% = taese tše 4, <40% = taese tše 3). Kgotlelelo ya Monagano ke matla a gago a monagano le bokgoni bja go kgotlelela kgahlanong le lefase la bosenyi la Durban.
tutorial.step1.title: Kgato ya 1: Taese ya Ditiragalo tša Letšatši & Kgotlelelo ya Monagano
tutorial.step1.zone: Mataese a Ditiro tša Letšatši le Letšatši, Khutšo le Moeletši wa Maano
tutorial.step2.badge: KGATO YA 2 GO TŠA 6 // LAESE YA LAETA
tutorial.step2.bullet1: Kgokološo ya Mafelelo = Sefahlego sa Taese + Phetošo ya Dipalo + Bonase ya Kgato 6 + Didirišwa.
tutorial.step2.bullet2: 6 goba go feta (Tala — Katlego e Sekilego): Tšwetša pele Dišupanako tša Dinyakišišo ka dikarolo tše +2 goba go lefa Diranta tše ntši.
tutorial.step2.bullet3: 4 goba 5 (Serolane — Katlego ya go Tlala Kotsi): Tšwetša pele ka karolo e +1, eupša e senya Khutšo e nyenyane.
tutorial.step2.bullet4: 1 go fihla go 3 (Hubedu — Go Palelwa / Ditlamorago tše mpe): Ga go tšwelopele, tahlegelo ya Khutšo, le go oketša Mogote wa Sepodisa.
tutorial.step2.desc: Swara goba o klike taese go tšwa go dock ya gago ya fase, gomme o klike Sebaka sa Tiragalo go node efe goba efe ya mmapa yeo e sa notlelwago. Difošo di rarollwa ka tsela e swanago: Boleng bja Taese + Phetolelo ya Stat + Phetolelo ya Blackout ya Kgato ya 6 + Kotlo ya Sebaka sa Manaba. Maemo a bontšhwa gabotse: 6+ Katlego e Hlwekilego, 4–5 e Senyegile, 1–3 Go Palelwa.
tutorial.step2.title: Kgato ya 2: Go Aba Taese go Dibaka tša Ditiragalo
tutorial.step2.zone: Dikgoba tša Tiro tša Node le Dikaonafatšo tša Dipalopalo
tutorial.step3.badge: KGATO YA 3 GO TŠA 6 // EKONOMI LE MATLA
tutorial.step3.bullet1: Lebenkele la Didirišwa tša Khukhuneng (Godimo ga HUD): Reka dikaonafatšo tša go ya go ile go Golden Dragon goba Point Road (+1 WAYA, +1 SETERATA).
tutorial.step3.bullet2: Megala ya Maano ya Sehlopha (1 ka Letšatši): Fihla go +1/+2 Rep le sehlopha go thoma bokgoni bja mahala bja letšatši le letšatši.
tutorial.step3.bullet3: Phedišo ya Ntlo ya Tšhireletšo: Šomiša Diranta go Tokišo ya Mahlomola (+25% Khutšo), Maano a Shebeen, Diesel (R300), le Phepafatšo ya Ditsela (R200).
tutorial.step3.desc: Matla a Eskom a fetoga go Dikgato tša 2 -> 4 -> 6 -> 2 bošego bjo bongwe le bo bongwe. Nakong ya Di-Blackout tša Kgato ya 6, dibaka tša di-server tša theknolotši ya godimo di a notlelwa ntle le ge o šomiša R300 go Diesel ya Jenereithara ya Backup, eupša ditiragalo tša sephiri go Port le Estates di hwetša Bonus ya +2 ya Fošo ka fase ga sephiri sa leswiswi.
tutorial.step3.title: Kgato ya 3: Di-Blackout tše di Fetogago (Load Shedding)
tutorial.step3.zone: Diranta (ZAR), Lebenkele la Didirišwa le Melemo ya Dihlopha
tutorial.step4.badge: KGATO YA 4 GO TŠA 6 // DITŠHOŠETŠO LE PHEDIŠO
tutorial.step4.bullet1: Go Fenngwa / Go Swarwa (Papadi e Fedile): Ge eba tlhaselo ya Brigadier Mokoena e fihla go 6/6, ntlo ya tšhireletšo e a thubja gomme papadi e fela ka go swarwa.
tutorial.step4.bullet2: Tahlegelo ya Moanegwa (Lefokisi Nandi): Ge eba go tšwa madi ga Nandi go fihla go 4/4 pele o mo fodiša, Nandi o hwa sa ruri ntlong ya gago (-30% Khutšo).
tutorial.step4.bullet3: Go Senyega ga Khutšo (0% Khutšo): Go fihla go 0% go baka boiketlo bjo bo maswe bjo bo jang Taese e 1 gosasa. Go theogela fase ga Rep ya sehlopha go -2 go baka tlhaselo ya dihlomo.
tutorial.step4.desc: Ditšhupanako tša sediko tša go arolwa di balela fase dikotsi tše di batamelago (Brigadier Mokoena's Sweep, Nandi's Wound, Izinkabi Hit Squads) le go latediša katlego ya gago ya dipatlisiso tša forensiki (Docket #409 Audit, Phone Cracking, Berth 14 Convoy). Ge ditšhupanako tša dinyakišišo di tlala, dikgahlangano tša mafelelo tša go tšhoša di a bulega.
tutorial.step4.title: Kgato ya 4: Diwate tša Kotsi & Nyakišišo
tutorial.step4.zone: Dišupanako tša Ditšhošetšo, Khutšo le Bokamoso bja Moanegwa
tutorial.step5.badge: KGATO YA 5 GO TŠA 6 // GODIMO GA HUD LE MEPE
tutorial.step5.bullet1: Go Tswalelwa ga Kgato 6: Di-server tša City Hall le Golden Dragon di a tima nakong ya Kgato 6—ntle le ge o lefa R300 ya diesel.
tutorial.step5.bullet2: Bonase ya Tšhireletšo ya Kgato 6: Go tsena Pier 2 Cold Storage go hwetša Bonase ya +2 nakong ya Kgato 6 ka lebaka la go tima ga mabone a boemakepe.
tutorial.step5.bullet3: Dithibelo tša SAPS: Ge eba Mogote o fihla go 4+, ditsela tša toropo di a tswalelwa, tša bitša R200 goba Taese e 1 go tshela ntle le ge o na le SAPS Radio Scanner.
tutorial.step5.desc: Maemo a godimo a Precinct Heat goba Threat a thoma diphalo tša di-roadblock tša SAPS tša go hloma dibetša magareng ga dikarolo. Go di tshela go senya Taese e 1 goba R200 ya pipa-molomo ya cold drink ka ntle le ge o na le sekenara se se kopolotšwego sa SAPS. Hwetša Seriti se sebotse sa Sehlopha go notlolla bokgoni bja togamaano bja gatee ka letšatši bjalo ka Grid Manipulation le Blue-Light Escorts.
tutorial.step5.title: Mogato wa 5: Di-Roadblock & Mehola ya Dihlopha
tutorial.step5.zone: Kgaotšo ya Mohlagase le Dithibelo tša Sepodisa (SAPS)
tutorial.step6.badge: KGATO YA 6 GO TŠA 6 // LESOLO LE GO BAPALA GAPE
tutorial.step6.bullet1: Go Fena Tiro 1 le go Tsena go Tiro 2: Hwetša dintlha tše 2 tša motheo go thoma Berth 14 Finale, gomme o kgotle "Tšwela pele go Tiro 2: The Bluff Refinery →".

tutorial.step6.bullet3: Papadi e Mpsha+ le Rejistara ya Fixer: Morago ga phenyo, lebelela Maemo a gago a Fixer go Rejistara ya eThekwini, kgoboketša Dibetšhe tše 6, gomme o thome Papadi e Mpsha+ go boloka didirišwa ka moka + R1,000!
